A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

our results show that the use of ALOS-2 SAR data in combination with Landsat 7/8 optical data, and a non-parametric RF algorithm, can be used to generate a national map of AGB at 1 ha resolution for the whole country.
the RF model was able to retrieve AGB with good accuracy, which was comparable to the accuracy obtained by other RF models trained with similar data and using the same algorithm.

the combination of optical and SAR data in the context of the RF algorithm was a successful approach for mapping AGB for the forests in the Colombian territory, which is an important step for assessing carbon stocks and dynamics in Colombia.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of SAR data and a multi-temporal optical data set allowed to generate a national map of AGB with an accuracy similar or better to those obtained with the use of optical data only.

the combination of optical and SAR data, and in-situ data, is a promising approach to map AGB at regional scale, and that this approach is particularly useful in regions where cloud cover is high and where optical data are not available, as in the case of the Colombian Orinoquia and Amazonia.

the combination of ALOS-2 and Landsat data, and RF modelling, can provide accurate estimates of AGB and carbon stocks at the country level, which are useful for national forest monitoring programs and for the reporting of national GHG inventories.
